correctness.rationale: Hamiltonian equations reproduce the displayed flow; p and V are positive/strictly single-well at k>a², giving unique closed energy ovals and exact physical-time/Euclidean-area quadratures with A_s_prime=T_s. The half-mass F_s(E)=int_0^{r_s}p_s(r)^-1/2 dr has an exact arcsinh primitive. Its signed difference tends to -2/sqrt(k) artanh(a/sqrt(k)); its derivative difference g(u) is bounded near 0 and O(u^-5/4) at infinity, so Abel kernel dominated convergence yields sqrt(E)(T_+-T_-)->sqrt2 int g=B, with the endpoint range O(E^-1/4). Each F_s_prime has 1/(4sqrt(k)u) tail and produces T(E)=log E/(sqrt(2kE))+O(E^-1/2), giving L. Integrating A_s_prime establishes the 2B area constant and 1/logE occupation bias. The exact mass-coordinate potential difference factorization in S=sinh(sqrt(k)z), h=cosh(sqrt(k)z)-1 has sign(a) because 3h²+5h+1+3(a²/k)h(h-1)>0; independent symbolic polynomial reduction modulo S²=h(h+2) verified the factorization. Positive Abel kernel then gives strict all-energy signed area ordering; reflection (x,y,a)->(-x,-y,-a) preserves full period/area, while explicit tanh inverse is global analytic.

value.rationale: The sign of the asymmetry coefficient is intrinsically invisible to every unsigned period/area measurement owing to exact reflection symmetry. An explicit signed residence statistic and strict finite-energy area comparison resolve a natural inverse-identifiability obstruction, adding mathematically motivated sharp information to the model rather than a routine period recomputation.

final_claim: For the cubic Hamiltonian center with p(x)=1+2ax+kx², V(x)=x²/2-ax³/3+kx⁴/4 and k>a², high-energy physical-time period scale L=1/sqrt(2k) and signed half-period difference B=-2 sqrt(2/k) artanh(a/sqrt(k)) recover (a,k) analytically. Signed Euclidean half-area difference scales to 2B; A_+(E)<A_-(E) at every E>0 when a>0 (opposite for a<0), though all full-period and full-area measurements are invariant under a->-a.
